feeds.title: Stonesoup
feeds.description: All about making healthy meals as quick and easy as possible without sacrificing flavor or resorting to processed crap. Helping you become the healthiest cook you can be, without spending hours in the kitchen.

feeds.title: JS Health Blog
feeds.description: Health blog posts full of healthy tips & nutritional facts and also on beauty, travel and fitness. Jessica Sepel a clinical nutritionist, the founder of JSHealth. She empowers people to give up dieting, nourish their bodies naturally, and find balance with food and fitness for life.

feeds.title: Changing Habits Blog
feeds.description: Healthy Eating Programs & Food Education. Take control of your health and vitality with education and real food. Learn how to change your habits today!

feeds.title: You Totally Got This
feeds.description: A Melbourn food blog authored by Rani Hansen is about all the tricks for getting a super healthy , delicious and quick meal on the table, without the stress

feeds.title: One Handed Cooks
feeds.description: Articles on New Recipes, Baby Food, Toddler Food, Family Food, Allergies, Nutrition and Fussy Eating. One Handed Cooks is a baby and toddler food blog that inspires people to cook beautifully simple, healthy food for their baby, toddler and primary school aged children. The recipes are all quick and easy to make, leaving you one free hand to wipe a nose, give a cuddle, or feed a hungry child.

feeds.title: The Fit Foodie
feeds.description: Covers topics on health, nutrition, beauty, mind and more. Nutritious versions of your favorite treats, devised with your health goals AND taste buds in mind. You can be healthy and have delicious food at the same time. Sally O'Neil, focuses on wholesome nutrition and the importance of fitness in her articles.

feeds.title: The Bircher Bar Blog
feeds.description: The Bircher Bar's blog Musings & Muesli shares thought-provoking, informative, and fun content on everything delicious, healthy, and nutritious! Everything you need to know about eating well and feeling great - get involved and leave your comments too! the Bircher Bar is a high-end resource for all things health, happiness, and living well.

feeds.title: Well Nourished
feeds.description: Blog posts about nourishing recipes and 'freestyle cooking' using fresh, local and seasonal foods. Georgia is a naturopathic doctor and mom of two. She also offers fantastic resources about building a whole foods pantry and raising healthy babies, toddlers and children.
